theme: Milan Design Week (Salone del Mobile) pre-trip quiet cool: city walks, espresso stops, hotel lobbies, neutral uniforms
why_today: Today (2026-04-11) sits right in the runway-up period before Milan Design Week / Salone del Mobile (Apr 20–26, 2026). That makes ‘packing / transit / espresso / hotel lobby / shadowy architecture’ feel naturally current on Xiaohongshu, while staying understated and editorial in a Hidden NY × JJJJound-friendly way.

trend_sources.name: Salone del Mobile.Milano — 2026 dates
trend_sources.why: Confirms Salone del Mobile 2026 runs Apr 20–26, 2026 (timely hook for the board).

trend_sources.name: IKEA Festival at Milan Design Week 2026
trend_sources.why: Shows public programming dates Apr 21–26, 2026 and a design × food crossover that matches this moodboard direction.

shared_visual_pattern: travel cues are subtle (window light, luggage, transit)
quiet everyday luxury (espresso, lobby surfaces, simple accessories)
title_ideas: 4月的‘设计周前’氛围感：安静的城市、咖啡、行李箱
最近只想存这种 quiet cool 的日常：低饱和、留白、影子
Hidden NY / JJJJound 那种克制感，我用15张图说明
caption_draft:
最近像是进入了‘设计周前的准备模式’：不是大张旗鼓，而是一些更安静的细节——路上的影子、咖啡杯的白、酒店大堂的光、行李箱靠窗的一瞬间。

这组 moodboard 想抓住那种 quiet cool 的城市节奏：干净、克制、但很有材质。

picks.title: Milan tram + city walk moment
picks.reason: 把地点和‘设计周城市步行’的节奏定下来，但画面依然干净克制。

picks.title: Abstract shadows on concrete stairs
picks.reason: 影子+材质=这套板子的骨架图，马上把‘冷静高级’拉出来。

picks.title: Minimalist overhead espresso cup
picks.reason: 咖啡细节是设计周语境的自然连接点：安静、干净、不做作。

picks.title: Minimalist hotel lobby geometry
picks.reason: ‘酒店大堂’这种中间空间很有旅行感，又能保持克制的设计审美。

picks.title: Suitcase by the window (grayscale calm)
picks.reason: 出发前最安静的那一刻：窗光、行李、留白，像编辑片的转场。

picks.title: Suitcase on escalator (in-between transit)
picks.reason: 有移动感但不吵，适合穿插在建筑/物件图之间增加节奏。

picks.title: Trench coat close-up detail
picks.reason: 4月的‘城市外套’细节图，比全身街拍更克制、更像日常制服。

picks.title: Retro sunglasses on white table
picks.reason: 小配件能让整组更像‘私藏灵感手册’，但仍保持极简。

picks.title: Notebook + coffee on table
picks.reason: 把生活方式和工作/出行计划连接起来：桌面、纸张、咖啡的质感很稳。

picks.title: Film camera on table (archive energy)
picks.reason: 一点点 archive / 胶片暗示，会把 Hidden NY/JJJJound 的味道压得更稳。

picks.title: Breakfast tray with coffee + pastries
picks.reason: ‘旅行早餐’是很有效的情绪图：日常但带一点轻奢，适合中后段。

picks.title: Shadows of people walking on pavement
picks.reason: 只拍影子更克制，也更有‘城市步行’的节奏和留白。

picks.title: Brutalist architecture with dramatic shadows
picks.reason: 给整组一个更强的建筑背景，像设计周期间随手拍到的立面。

picks.title: Shadowed round stone on marble surface
picks.reason: 把‘材质’放大：石材/光影/留白，作为转场或封面候选都很强。

picks.title: Modern building facade with minimal windows
picks.reason: 收尾用一张更‘冷’的立面，把整组落在城市的结构感上。
